citations.citation: For the invention and development of optical lattice clocks, in which neutral atoms trapped at a magic wavelength brought atomic frequency standards to the 10^-18 level
for the invention and development of optical lattice clocks, in which neutral atoms held at the magic wavelength brought atomic timekeeping to the 10^-18 level
for the invention of the optical lattice clock, trapping neutral atoms at the magic wavelength, and its development to accuracy and stability at the 10^-18 level
for the invention and development of optical lattice clocks, in which neutral atoms trapped at a magic wavelength enabled atomic frequency measurement and comparison at the 10^-18 level
For the invention and realisation of the optical lattice clock, in which neutral atoms trapped at the magic wavelength enable timekeeping with uncertainties near 1e-18
for the invention and development of optical lattice clocks, trapping neutral atoms at the magic wavelength to reach a fractional uncertainty near 10^-18
for the invention and development of optical lattice clocks, in which neutral atoms trapped at the magic wavelength made frequency measurement at the 1e-18 level possible
For the invention and development of optical lattice clocks, trapping many neutral atoms at the magic wavelength to reach accuracy and stability at the 10^-18 level
